import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/test_1.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Rename columns in df0 to match the target schema suffix "_15"
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={
    'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
    'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
    'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15',
    'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
    'Family': 'Family_15',
    'Freedom': 'Freedom_15'
})

# Select only the columns needed from df0 (all target columns with suffix _15 plus Country and Region)
df0_selected = df0_renamed[[
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15'
]]

# df1 already has columns matching the target schema suffix "_17"
# Select only the columns needed from df1
df1_selected = df1[[
    'Country',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17',
    'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]]

# Join df0_selected and df1_selected on 'Country'
# Since df0 has 'Region' and df1 does not, keep 'Region' from df0
# Use inner join to keep only countries present in both sources (consistent with target examples)
df_merged = pd.merge(df0_selected, df1_selected, on='Country', how='inner')

# After merge, 'Region' is from df0_selected, so it is present
# Reorder columns to match the target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy_15', 'Family_15', 'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17',
    'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]

df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

# Ensure data types match target schema:
# According to target schema:
# - 'Country', 'Region' are strings (object in pandas)
# - 'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Rank_17' are integers
# - The rest are floats

# Convert ranks to integer (some source data might be float)
df_final['Happiness_Rank_15'] = df_final['Happiness_Rank_15'].astype(int)
df_final['Happiness_Rank_17'] = df_final['Happiness_Rank_17'].astype(int)

# Convert Region and Country to string explicitly (in case of any issues)
df_final['Country'] = df_final['Country'].astype(str)
df_final['Region'] = df_final['Region'].astype(str)

# Convert all other columns to float
float_columns = [
    'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
    'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17', 'Economy_17',
    'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17', 'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]
df_final[float_columns] = df_final[float_columns].astype(float)

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_83/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
